theses.observation: ZIL printed a high-volume upper wick to $0.004652 before steadily bleeding down 12.5% intraday to $0.003499, while hourly volume collapsed from 704M ZIL to under 10M ZIL.
theses.evidence: 1H OHLCV shows the peak volume spike (704.5M ZIL) occurred during the surge to $0.004652, but price closed lower at $0.004166. Subsequent hourly candles show continuous lower highs with volume drying up to 8.18M ZIL near the $0.003462 low, supporting a conditional SHORT trigger at $0.003455 with invalidation at $0.0043915.
theses.non_obvious_interpretation: The massive volume spike at the peak was not organic momentum buying, but aggressive distribution into retail breakout chasers. The subsequent volume decay reflects an absence of bid-side support rather than healthy consolidation.
theses.mechanism: Supply dumped into market buys at the wick top exhausted buy-side order book depth. With buyers sidelined and liquidity thin below $0.00346, even modest selling pressure can trigger a cascading loss of support toward lower liquidity pools at $0.002518 (TP1) and $0.001582 (TP2).
theses.contradiction_or_risk: A sudden rebound reclaiming $0.0043915 invalidates the short bias, signaling that overhead supply was absorbed or a short squeeze is in progress.
theses.confirmation_condition: A clean 1H candle close below $0.003455 accompanied by an expansion in sell volume.
theses.why_reader_would_care: It provides a clear risk-managed framework to trade or avoid altcoin liquidity wicks, protecting readers from catching falling knives without trigger confirmation.
